rdf:Description.rdfs:label: reader
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a person who reads publications.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: relates to person
rdf:Description.vann:example:
:my-person pro:holdsRoleInTime :my-person-role .
:my-person-role a pro:RoleInTime ; pro:relatesToPerson :my-other-person . pro:withRole pro:archivist .
:my-other-person a foaf:Person .
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a time-indexed situation and a person who represents the context for that situation (e.g. relating the role of an supervisor with respect to the graduate student being supervised).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: with role
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An object property connecting an agent's role in time to a definition of the type of role held by this agent, specified as an instance of the class pro:Role or of one of its sub-classes.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: relates to organization
rdf:Description.vann:example:
:my-person pro:holdsRoleInTime :my-person-role .
:my-person-role a pro:RoleInTime ; pro:relatesToOrganization :my-organization . pro:withRole pro:archivist .
:my-organization a foaf:Organization .
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a time-indexed situation and an organization that represents the context for that situation (e.g. relating the role of member to the institution of which that person is a member).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blogger
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of an author who writes blog posts.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: critic
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of an author who writes evaluations and criticisms of, for example, plays or other works of art.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: author's agent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A person who finds work for professional authors, manages their contracts, and works to advance their careers, charging their clients as fees for their services a percentage of the money made from the authors' writings.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: role in time
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A particular situation that describe a role an agent may have, that can be restricted to a particular time interval.
rdf:Description.skos:note: A role in time describes always: - a particular role R - a particular agent A holding R - a particular time interval T in which A holds R (optional) - one or more entities (e.g. a particular bibliographic entity or a specific institution) that defines a context for R held by A. At least one contextual entity should be specified for a particular role.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Publishing Roles Ontology (PRO)
rdf:Description.dc:creator: David Shotton (https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5506-523X)
Silvio Peroni (https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0530-4305)
rdf:Description.dc:title: The Publishing Roles Ontology (PRO)
rdf:Description.dcterms:bibliographicCitation: Peroni, S., Shotton, D., Vitali, F. (2012). Scholarly publishing and Linked Data: describing roles, statuses, temporal and contextual extents. In Sack, H., Pellegrini, T. (Eds.), Proceedings of the 8th International Conference on Semantic Systems (i-Semantics 2012): 9-16. New York, New York, USA: ACM. https://doi.org/10.1145/2362499.2362502. Open Access at: https://scholar.archive.org/work/tgbxvpuqbjbtvbj6mwt77gtx7m/access/wayback/http://speroni.web.cs.unibo.it/publications/peroni-2012-scholarly-publishing-linked.pdf

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: copy editor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of an editor who undertakes alterations to the text of a document submitted for publication to improve the formatting, style and accuracy of text, or to bring the text into the house style of the publisher (e.g. Americanization of British spelling), without intentionally altering the substance or meaning of the text.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: senior editor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of the person who has senior responsibility for the editorial operations and policies for a particular publication, usually acting under the authority of the Editor-in-Chief.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: reviewer
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a person who subjects a publication to a written review and critical analysis of its content, scope and quality.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has value
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an entity and a value in time situation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: journalist
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of an author who writes newspaper or magazine news reports or articles.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: editor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a person who selects and prepares for publication material created and submitted by authors, having oversight of its content, format and presentation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: publisher
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a person or an organization that published material, or of a publisher's employee who has responsibility for such publications.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: producer
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of someone who acts as a producer.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: executive editor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of an editor who has executive responsibility for the production of particular publication, usually acting under the authority of the Editor-in-Chief.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: peer reviewer
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of an academic peer in evaluating a manuscript submitted by an author for publication as a journal article on behalf of the journal editor, or a conference paper on behalf of the conference programme committee, and in deciding whether it is suitable for acceptance, usually subject to revisions suggested by the peer-reviewer.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: time indexed situation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A situation that is explicitly indexed at some time for at least one entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: relates to document
rdf:Description.vann:example:
:my-person pro:holdsRoleInTime :my-person-role .
:my-person-role a pro:RoleInTime ; pro:relatesToDocument :my-document . pro:withRole pro:archivist .
:my-document a foaf:Document .
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a time-indexed situation describing a publishing role and a document that represents the context for that situation (e.g. relating the role of editor or peer-reviewer to the document being edited or peer-reviewed).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: person
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A person.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: holds role in time
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an agent and a role that the agent holds.
rdf:Description.skos:note:
This is done via the indirection:
foaf:Agent pro:holdsRoleInTime [ a pro:RoleInTime ; pro:withRole pro:Role ] .
The ontology permits one to specify the time period over which a role is held, and the other contextual entities to which that agent's role relates.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: relates to
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a time-indexed situation and an entity representing the context for that situation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: archivist
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a person who manages, undertakes and supervises the work of an archive.
rdf:Description.skos:note: This term is typically used with respect to a document archive, whereas the term data curator is used with respect to a data archive.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is document context for
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a document and the role for which that document provides the context (e.g. relating a document to the role of author or peer-reviewer of that document).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: guest editor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of someone who is a guest editor, for example for a special themed issue of a journal.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: within context
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The specific context within which the fact of the entity having the value is relevant.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: printer
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of an agent involved in printing documents, either a company providing printing services or an individual engaged in the process of printing documents.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ghost writer
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a professional writer who assists an aspiring author lacking authorship skills to write a book or article for publication, for example by helping the author to create grammatically correct and lucid prose, or who writes the book on behalf of the named author, without himself/herself claiming authorship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: production editor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of an editor who takes responsibility for the passage of a document through the various stages of the publication workflow from the submitted manuscript to the final publication, including responsibility for scheduling and budget.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: series editor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of the person who has editorial responsibility for publication series, for example a book series.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: proof reader
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a person who reads the proofs of documents to detect any errors prior to final publication.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: contributor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role an agent has of contribution of some material (for example an article to a magazine).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: organization
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An organization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: copyright owner
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of owning the copyright to a publication, usually held by the author or by the publishing house that publishes the author's work.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: deputy editor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a senior editor of a publication who deputizes for the Editor-in-Chief.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is organization context for
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an organization and the role for which that organization provides the context (e.g. relating an institution to the role of member held by a person).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: at time
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A time interval during which a status is held by a document.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: librarian
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a person who manages, undertakes and supervises the work of a library.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: editor-in-chief
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of the person who has final responsibility for the editorial operations and policies for a particular publication.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: managing editor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of an editor who has management responsibility for the production of particular publication, usually acting under the authority of the Executive Editor and the Editor-in-Chief.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: publishing role
rdf:Description.vann:example:
:my-person pro:holdsRoleInTime :my-person-role .
:my-person-role a pro:RoleInTime ; pro:withRole pro:archivist .
pro:archivist a pro:PublishingRole .
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A role an agent may have with respect to the publishing process.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Individual members of this class are used to specify particular roles.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: at time
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The particular temporal instant or time period in which the situation takes place.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: commissioning editor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of an editor who actively commissions authors to write books to be published by the publishing house for which the commissioning editor works.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: illustrator
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of an agent that illustrates a document.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: agent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any kind of agents, such as a person, a group, an organization or a software agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: for entity
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a time-indexed situation and an entity involved in it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: distributor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a person who distributes or disseminates publications or other resources.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: translator
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of an agent that translates a document into another language.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: value in time
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A particular kind of time-indexed situation that represents a hub linking the entity having a particular value, the value itself and the temporal and contextual extents from which the entity-value relationship depends.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: with value
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between the value in time situation and the actual value held by the entity partaking in that situation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: role
rdf:Description.vann:example:
:my-person pro:holdsRoleInTime :my-person-role .
:my-person-role a pro:RoleInTime ; pro:withRole pro:archivist .
pro:archivist a pro:Role .
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A role an agent may have. Individual members of this class or its sub-classes are used to specify particular roles.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: author
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person has of authorship of some material (for example a document).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is role in
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between the definition of a specific role and the situation of an agent holding that role.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is role held by
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a role in time that an agent holds, or a contribution situation that an agent makes, and that agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has interval end date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The end date of a time interval

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: compiler
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role an agent has of compiling a number of items into a compilation or collection.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has time indexed setting
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an entity and a time-indexed situation it is involved in.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: document
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An abstract class defining any kinds of publishing work.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is person context for
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a person and the role for which that person provides the context (e.g. relating a graduate student to the role of supervisor held by a faculty member).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has interval date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A date value assigned to a time interval.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: biographer
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of an author who writes biographies.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has interval start date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The start date of a time interval

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is related to role in time
rdf:Description.vann:example:
:my-person pro:holdsRoleInTime :my-person-role .
:my-person-role a pro:RoleInTime ; pro:withRole pro:archivist .
:my-entity pro:isRelatedToRoleInTime :my-person-role .
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an entity and the role for which that entity provides the context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: time interval
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Two (starting and ending) points in time that define a particular period of time.
